skill.name: upstash-qstash
skill.description: Build Upstash QStash workflows for serverless queues, scheduled HTTP jobs, webhook delivery, retries, callbacks, and signature verification.
skill.summary: Guides reliable Upstash QStash message delivery and serverless scheduling patterns.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The single static finding is a false positive caused by Markdown inline code formatting around related skill names. I found no evidence of command execution, prompt injection, data exfiltration, or malicious intent in SKILL.md.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 68 uses backticks only for Markdown inline formatting of related skill names. There is no executable code, shell invocation, or user-controlled command construction.

content.value_statement: Serverless applications need reliable background jobs without queue infrastructure. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code design QStash messaging, scheduling, retries, and webhook handling.
actual_capabilities: Explains QStash message publishing for HTTP endpoint delivery.
Guides recurring serverless cron and delayed job design.
Highlights webhook signature verification with current signing keys.
Covers retries, callbacks, failure callbacks, and endpoint error handling.
Describes deduplication, URL groups, and payload reference patterns.
limitations: It provides guidance only and does not provision Upstash resources.
It cannot verify live account limits or current billing plan details.
QStash delivery requires public HTTP endpoints, not private localhost targets.
Implementation details must be checked against the current Upstash documentation.

use_cases.title: Design Background Job Delivery
use_cases.description: Plan HTTP-based asynchronous tasks with retries, deduplication, and fast endpoint acknowledgments.

use_cases.title: Replace Serverless Cron Glue
use_cases.description: Create recurring QStash schedules for maintenance jobs, notifications, and data refresh tasks.

use_cases.title: Harden Webhook Processing
use_cases.description: Review signature verification, callback handling, and failure paths before production launch.

prompt_templates.title: Plan My First Queue
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a single background task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a simple Upstash QStash flow for one background task. Include the endpoint shape, delivery behavior, retry needs, and signature verification checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Scheduled Job
prompt_templates.scenario: Recurring serverless work with operational safeguards.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a QStash cron workflow for my recurring job. Cover schedule choice, endpoint response timing, retries, callbacks, and monitoring signals.

prompt_templates.title: Review A Production Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Pre-launch review for reliability and security.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my planned QStash workflow for production readiness. Check signature verification, deduplication, payload size, error handling, and failure callback behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Architect A Multi-Service Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced design across several endpoints or services.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a multi-endpoint QStash architecture using URL groups, delayed delivery, callbacks, and deduplication. Explain tradeoffs, failure modes, and operational checks.

output_examples.input: I need a background job to send welcome emails after signup.
output_examples.output: A QStash delivery plan with the publish event, public email endpoint, signature checks, retry policy, deduplication key, and failure callback.

output_examples.input: I want a daily data refresh in a serverless app.
output_examples.output: A scheduled workflow covering cron timing, endpoint timeout limits, payload reference storage, callback tracking, and rate limit review.

output_examples.input: My webhook endpoint sometimes processes duplicate messages.
output_examples.output: A remediation checklist for idempotent handlers, QStash deduplication, persistent operation keys, and safe retry behavior.

best_practices: Always verify QStash signatures before processing delivered messages.
Return quickly from endpoints and move slow work into follow-up tasks.
Use deduplication and idempotent handlers for critical operations.
anti_patterns: Do not send large payloads when a durable reference is safer.
Do not rely on private or localhost endpoints for production delivery.
Do not use one retry policy for every message type without review.

faq.question: What is this skill best for?
faq.answer: It is best for designing reliable QStash queues, scheduled HTTP jobs, webhook delivery, and retry behavior.

faq.question: Does it create Upstash resources for me?
faq.answer: No. It gives implementation guidance, reviews designs, and helps plan configurations that you apply in your environment.

faq.question: Can it help with webhook security?
faq.answer: Yes. It emphasizes QStash signature verification, endpoint authentication boundaries, and safe failure handling.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is marked compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I prepare before using it?
faq.answer: Prepare your endpoint URL, task purpose, expected payload, retry needs, and any timing or rate limit constraints.

faq.question: Does it replace current Upstash documentation?
faq.answer: No. Use it for workflow guidance, then verify exact API details against the current Upstash documentation.
